purpose: Song-level Kalaignar-authorship evidence register for every numbered lyric in the controlling scan, holding structured evidence items from every inspected witness, and the evidence-backed proposed public inclusion set derived from them.

controlling_source.reading_method: page images rendered from the controlling PDF and read directly; OCR was not used as textual authority

evidence_apparatus.controlling_2024: Each film section prints an “இப்படத்தில் இடம் பெற்ற பாடல்கள்” box listing that film's songs with a per-song lyricist column. This per-song column is the decisive song-level authorship apparatus in this source.
evidence_apparatus.earlier_1989: The 1989 witness prints no lyricist column. Its authorship claim is explicit but made at collection scope, enumerated by its contents; twelve of its forty sections additionally print an editorial note naming கலைஞர் for that song.

evidence_levels.D: Implicit or non-song-specific evidence. Not sufficient for public inclusion.

decision_vocabulary.established-kalaignar: Song-specific source evidence attributes the lyric to Kalaignar.
decision_vocabulary.established-other: Song-specific source evidence attributes the lyric to a named writer other than Kalaignar.
decision_vocabulary.unresolved: The source leaves the lyricist undetermined for this song. Not a finding of non-authorship.
decision_vocabulary.insufficient-evidence: No song-specific authorship evidence is present in the controlling source. Not a finding of non-authorship.

inclusion_rule: A song enters the proposed public inclusion set if and only if at least one evidence item supports Kalaignar at evidence level A, B or C and no material conflict is declared. Level D never qualifies, whichever witness it comes from. unresolved and insufficient-evidence are never converted into “not Kalaignar”.
scope_limits: This register adjudicates lyric authorship only, across the printed witnesses inspected.
The 1989 volume is an earlier compilation witness, never a contemporary original-film credit.
Absence of a song from the 1989 witness is a source fact and is never treated as negative evidence.
No authorship inference was drawn from theme, vocabulary, ideology, poetic style, chronology, or what sounds like Kalaignar.
No date, venue, occasion, printed page number, song boundary, authorship or rights status has been supplied that the sources do not print.
This register makes no rights or licensing determination.
Archival attribution_status is untouched: all 54 records remain anthology-attributed.

evidence_item_schema.note: printed_page_if_known and attribution_as_printed_or_source_claim may be null where the source prints no such value; every other field is always present.

decision_rule.material_conflict: Two or more evidence items make incompatible positive attributions — one supports Kalaignar and another supports a different named writer for the same song, both at level A, B or C. A source declaring its own inability to confirm authorship is NOT a material conflict: it is limiting evidence, not a competing attribution.
order: If a material conflict exists the decision is unresolved and the song is never automatically included.
Else if any evidence item supports Kalaignar at level A, B or C the decision is established-kalaignar.
Else if any evidence item supports a named other writer at level A, B or C the decision is established-other.
Else if any evidence item limits song-level attribution the decision is unresolved.
decision_rule.inclusion: public_inclusion is true if and only if the decision is established-kalaignar and no material conflict is declared. The decision is a property of the record, not of any single evidence item: a record may hold positive items and limiting items at once.
